incidents.name: Telcoin CloneableProxy re-initialisation
incidents.notes: The Telcoin wallet CloneableProxy left its OpenZeppelin _initialized flag clear, so anyone could call initialize(address,bytes) again to point the proxy at their own implementation and have it delegatecall arbitrary code that transferred out the wallet's TEL.

sources.ref: onchain review: CloneableProxy 0x56BCADff30680EBB540a84D75c182A5dC61981C0 created 2021-11-23T10:50:52Z by 0x0d0fbdfb774049aea1aaf8d88cd41cd10830c5a3, not the attack-tx sender 0xdb4b84f0e601e40a02b54497f26e03ef33f3a5b7; no EIP-1967 Upgraded event, 762.3 days old. The PoC reads storage slot 0 before and after and shows _initialized flipping from 0 to 1 during the exploit, confirming the proxy had never been marked initialised. Reported loss ~$1.24M across the wallet clones drained in the campaign.

deployment-basis recheck: the CloneableProxy's 45-byte runtime is an EIP-1167 clone of the fixed master 0x10d0e9755c67ab37089acb4f51e8b4ee407fe853, and the master in turn delegatecalls the address in the EIP-1967 beacon slot. prestateTracer on the attack tx shows that slot held 0x3f443c31dab3dab882f9fe621f97b74c3c14837d before the exploit, and the exploit's re-initialisation is precisely what overwrote it with the attacker module 0x10e5c8d3537856f141272e1c39befdab4dd8bde0 that is then delegatecalled. Binary-searching the slot over [21704647, 51546495] (i.e. up to the block before the incident) shows 0x3f443c31... constant from creation; the runtimes of both the master and 0x3f443c31... are byte-identical at the creation and incident blocks. Deployment is the correct basis; 762.3 days.
